description: This file is a JavaScript module for CodeMirror, implementing the show-hint (autocomplete) functionality with UI components, event handling, and hint rendering logic.

classes.name: p
classes.description: Class handling the autocomplete widget, managing hint display, user interaction, and selection.

classes.name: n
classes.description: Class representing the hint dropdown list, handling hint selection and navigation.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the autocomplete widget and cleans up event listeners.

methods.name: active
methods.description: Checks if the completion is currently active.

methods.name: pick
methods.description: Selects the current hint and inserts it into the editor.

methods.name: showHints
methods.description: Displays the list of hints based on current input.

methods.name: cursorActivity
methods.description: Handles cursor movement to determine if the hint should be updated or closed.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the hint list asynchronously or synchronously.

methods.name: finishUpdate
methods.description: Finalizes the hint list update and displays the widget.

methods.name: showWidget
methods.description: Creates and shows the hint dropdown widget.

methods.name: buildOptions
methods.description: Constructs configuration options for the hint system.
